title: ApplyWise — AI CVs, Cover Letters & ATS Optimization
excerpt: Paste a job description. Get an ATS-optimized CV, tailored cover letter, and a match score with concrete fixes — in 60 seconds.
content_html:
Beat AI. Land more interviews.

Get hired with CV that actually beat the bots.

Paste any job description. We generate a tailored CV and cover letter, score it against the ATS, and tell you exactly what to fix.

Free to try No credit card Built on top AI models

Four tools. One outcome.

Everything you need to land the job.

Tools built on top of Claude and ChatGPT models

No card required · First generation on us

How it works

From job description to interview-ready in 60 seconds.

No more rewriting your CV for every application. Paste the job description, paste your background, and we do the tailoring — keyword by keyword.

No card required Your data stays yours ~60s per document

AI draft

Leveraged synergistic frameworks to deliver robust, scalable solutions in a dynamic environment.

Humanized

Built and shipped tools that cut onboarding time by 40% across three product teams.

AI-detector risk

High

Humanizer

Sound like you, not a chatbot.

Recruiters spot AI-generated writing in seconds — and detectors like GPTZero and Turnitin flag it before your CV reaches a human. Our Humanizer rewrites any draft so it reads natural, specific, and unmistakably yours, with a side-by-side diff of every change.

  • Strip generic AI phrases ("leveraged", "synergistic", "passionate about")
  • Rewrite in your voice — concise, specific, evidence-first
  • Bypass ATS AI-detection filters used by top employers
  • See every edit with a clear before/after diff

Find a Job Prompt Library

The prompt library built for job hunters.

Stop guessing what to ask AI. Browse hundreds of curated prompts for CVs, cover letters, recruiter outreach, interview prep, salary negotiation and more — written by career coaches and ex-recruiters.

  • Filter by job stage, role, and experience level
  • Free and premium prompts — copy, paste, get results
  • Tested with ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini

Everything in one place

One toolkit for the whole job hunt.

From the first prompt to the signed offer — every step of the modern job search, powered by AI you can actually trust.

Prompt Library

Hundreds of curated prompts for CVs, interviews, outreach and negotiation — written by career coaches.

Tailored CV Generator

Paste a job description and get a keyword-optimized CV shaped around your real experience in seconds.

Cover Letters that fit

Personal, specific letters that show why you — not another candidate — belong in the role.

ATS Match Scoring

See exactly which keywords, sections, and formatting choices are costing you interviews.

AI Humanizer

Rewrite AI-sounding drafts into natural, human writing that gets past detectors and recruiters.

Job-Specific Tailoring

Every output is shaped to one job description — no more copy-paste applications.

60-Second Turnaround

Go from blank page to interview-ready docs in under a minute — for every role you apply to.

5 Languages

Full experience in English, German, Spanish, Italian and French — write in the market's language.

Free & Private

Use the core tools with no sign-up. Your CV data stays yours — never sold, never trained on.

The numbers

Built for the modern job hunt.

Most CVs get filtered before a human sees them. We fix that.

Free to start · No card · Results in under a minute
